title: Meta-Amortized Cognitive Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.31914v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cognitive modeling is highly iterative. Researchers repeatedly revise model structures, parameterizations, covariates, and experimental designs as theories evolve and data accumulates. Amortized Bayesian inference with neural networks provides rapid estimation for individual models, but every revision requires new simulations and training. Here, we introduce CogFormerV2, a meta-amortized framework that enables researchers to specify, revise, and fit cognitive models with a single network, carrying amortization across an entire space of models all at once. Trained once in about a day on a single GPU, it delivers accurate, well-calibrated posteriors across more than 14.6 billion model configurations spanning binary, multi-alternative, and continuous decisions, with varying parameter sets, covariate structures, trial counts, and contamination levels. translated_abstract: 认知建模是一个高度迭代的过程。随着理论的发展与数据的积累，研究者需要反复修改模型结构、参数化方式、协变量以及实验设计。基于神经网络的摊销贝叶斯推断能够为单个模型提供快速估计，但每一次模型修改都需要重新进行模拟和训练。在此，我们提出了 CogFormerV2——一个元摊销框架，使研究者能够用单个网络来指定、修改和拟合认知模型，将摊销能力一次性覆盖整个模型空间。该网络仅需在单块GPU上训练约一天，即可在超过146亿个模型配置上给出准确且校准良好的后验分布，这些配置涵盖二元、多选项和连续决策任务，并具有不同的参数集合、协变量结构、试次数量和污染水平。它可以拟合来自不同行为任务的真实经验数据，并可通过……扩展到新模型。
tldr: 该论文提出CogFormerV2元摊销框架，用单个网络一次性将贝叶斯推断摊销至整个认知模型空间，仅需在单GPU上训练约一天，即可对涵盖二元、多选项和连续决策的超过146亿个模型配置快速给出准确且校准良好的后验分布，从而免去每次模型修改后重新模拟与训练的成本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CogFormerV2, a meta-amortized framework that amortizes Bayesian inference across an entire space of cognitive models with a single network, delivering accurate, well-calibrated posteriors over more than 14.6 billion model configurations after just one day of training on a single GPU, eliminating the need to re-simulate and retrain for every model revision.
